classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the submarine's depth using tangent and compare it with the reef depth.

content.prompt:
A submarine initially at sea level dives at an angle of $11^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

At a horizontal distance of $1200$ m there is an uncharted reef at a depth of $240$ m.

Will the submarine pass over the reef? Give the clearance to the nearest metre.

answer.worked:
Let $d$ be the submarine's depth after travelling $1200$ m horizontally.
$$\begin{align*}\tan 11^{\circ}&=\frac{d}{1200}\\d&=1200\tan 11^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
The clearance above the reef is
$$\begin{align*}c&=240-1200\tan 11^{\circ}\\c&\approx7\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$
The submarine is shallower than the reef, so it passes over it by approximately $7$ m.
